variants.name: Жильник
variants.design: Adult male, lean former municipal worker, recognizable human face with cloudy irises and close cropped hair. Rope-like dark fungal mycelium tendons wind around calves and neck UNDER mostly intact skin; subtle pale lichen only along jawline. Narrow silhouette, raised heels, springy forward-leaning sprint-ready stance, thin long arms. Worn slate work trousers and torn ochre short-sleeve overshirt, no gear.

variants.name: Косой
variants.design: Adult female, wiry angular build, head and torso tilt to one side from an asymmetrically contracted neck tendon. Chalk-white filamentous crust grows across one collarbone and along one forearm; face remains clearly human, short matted dark hair. Long powerful legs, bent elbows, tense poised-to-dash stance. Ruined dark red tracksuit jacket unzipped over gray shirt, dusty black trousers. No large shoulder pads.

variants.name: Пружинник
variants.design: Adult male, extremely lean long-legged build, compact hunched shoulders and shortened-looking taut waist. Thin translucent gray fungal membrane tightly hugs the shins and forearms like natural wraps, black branching veins at temples; face still exposed and human. Narrow chest, knees flexed ready to accelerate, fingers curled naturally. Sleeveless faded blue undershirt and torn light khaki work trousers, bare dirty forearms.

variants.name: Теневик
variants.design: Adult female ambush infected with a compact folded posture, long loose arms and splayed fingers touching the ground lightly. Intact human face half-obscured by matted brown hair, soot-gray skin and a matte moss-like microbial felt grows down the spine and outer shoulders, no mushroom caps. Narrow elongated scapula silhouette, knees deeply bent. Torn dark green raincoat ending at hips and gray trousers, no backpack.

variants.name: Лазутчик
variants.design: Adult male ambush infected in a low near-crawling crouch, entire figure fully visible. Long asymmetric forearms but only two arms, prominent knuckles, flattened shoulders. Thin black fungal scales form camouflage along ribs and outer thighs; human eyes still visible beneath a bony low brow, shaved patches of scalp. Faded brown maintenance jumpsuit with one sleeve missing. Dry dusty textures, no bulky growths.

variants.name: Складень
variants.design: Adult male ambush infected with broad loose folds of gray skin and pale fungal biofilm around neck and elbows, folded compact squat with one hand bracing a wall-free empty air space beside him and the other low at knee level. Bald human head tucked between raised narrow shoulders, eyes partly obscured by translucent skin film, recognizable nose and mouth. Tattered charcoal sleeveless coat and earth-brown pants. Distinctive accordion-like neck folds rather than mushroom face.

types.name: Сенсорный заражённый
types.role: Поиск цели по звуку и вибрациям

variants.name: Резонатор
variants.design: Adult male blind humanoid with both eyes sealed by a smooth continuous chalky calcified strip across the upper face, intact human nose and closed mouth visible below. Several long vertical pleated resonating folds descend from throat onto sternum, like biological bellows, no flower or mushroom fan on head. Upright listening pose with head tilted, slender two-arm two-leg body. Ruined gray laboratory work coat over brown trousers.

variants.name: Усик
variants.design: Adult female blind humanoid, smooth dark fungal membrane covers only the eye sockets. Delicate short straight sensory filaments project laterally from jaw and forearms, stiff subtle feelers not tentacles, not flower petals. Head has recognizable human contours and exposed closed lips, sparse dark hair, long neck, one hand held open listening for air vibration. Faded petrol-blue utility shirt and dusty beige trousers. No cranial mushroom crown.

variants.name: Гул
variants.design: Adult male heavy-shouldered blind infected, head small and bald with eyes closed beneath flat gray scar tissue. Two prominent ridged resonance chambers form along SIDES OF NECK below ears, elongated vertical oval cavities with tightly closed slits, no yellow sacs. Wide rib cage under intact mottled skin, arms slightly apart sensing vibrations. Tattered rust-brown sweater and dark gray trousers. Head itself remains human-shaped, no flower-shaped growths.

variants.name: Сланец
variants.design: Adult male broad heavy humanoid, body armored in overlapping thin charcoal SLATE-like mineralized fungal lamellae concentrated asymmetrically on left shoulder, outer thighs and forearms; layered lengthwise jagged dark ridges, not orange mushroom plates. Human face exposed with pale cracked cheek and close cropped hair. Low center of gravity, thick legs, two massive hands. Remnants of faded navy warehouse coveralls, no equipment.

variants.name: Кокон
variants.design: Adult female broad powerful adult humanoid wrapped in dense pale gray fibrous mycelial cords forming a thick uneven cocoon across torso and shoulders. Exposed human face emerges from a narrow collar opening with normal head shape; hands and boots visible, slow imposing stance. Rope-fiber armor, not round tumors or orange fungus caps. Torn maroon industrial overalls partly visible beneath corded shell, heavy asymmetrical right forearm.

variants.name: Роговик
variants.design: Adult male stocky adult infected, dark brown hornlike keratin ridges grow LENGTHWISE along shoulders and forearms like rugged longitudinal beams, chest leathery and relatively bare rather than mushroom-plated. Human face with distorted jaw and scarred forehead, very short gray hair. Thick column legs, hunched defensive pose with one arm shielding torso. Faded moss-green work trousers, remnants of gray undershirt, no weapons.

variants.name: Сотовик
variants.design: Adult male tall thin humanoid with a single large asymmetrical honeycomb-textured porous fungal mass growing from RIGHT upper back and shoulder, dark gray-green cavities releasing a small restrained pale dust wisp. Not round yellow sacs. Face mostly human and tired-looking, gaunt torso, thin arms, one shoulder lifted by growth. Torn beige utility shirt and charcoal work trousers. Large readable one-sided shoulder silhouette.

variants.name: Дымарь
variants.design: Adult female humanoid with unusually deep rib cage and several closed vertical slit vents running down BOTH lateral ribs beneath pale intact skin, breathing out thin smoky spore wisps at flank height. No spherical blisters, no mushroom crown. Hair shaved close, intact recognizable human face, heavy rounded upper torso tapering to slim legs. Ruined dark plum sleeveless jacket and dusty gray trousers. Arms spread slightly so rib vents are visible.

variants.name: Стручник
variants.design: Adult male humanoid with a cluster of long dry split REED-POD shapes rising close along the spine and projecting just above shoulders, natural papery brown fungal tubes with narrow openings, no flowers and no mushroom caps. Lean human face and torso, deep hoodless green work shirt torn open at upper back, tan trousers. A few dust particles drift from pods, entire figure sharply visible, elegant narrow vertical silhouette.

variants.name: Перекос
variants.design: One single gigantic adult humanoid, about2.7m implied height, only ONE human head TWO arms TWO legs, no fused bodies. Extreme asymmetry: left shoulder and left arm massively enlarged by a dark fibrous support lattice, right arm long lean and reaching low. Skull human-shaped with face exposed, ribs and torso covered by intact leathery gray skin, black mycelium cables along limbs. Wide triangular silhouette, remnants of industrial gray coveralls at waist and legs. Full-body intimidating grounded pose.

variants.name: Колонна
variants.design: One single gigantic adult female humanoid, about2.9m implied height, only ONE human head TWO arms TWO legs, no fused creatures. Very tall narrow columnlike silhouette, elongated trunk and neck, thick pillar legs, heavy forearms hanging nearly to knees. Pale mineralized fungal shell forms a vertical spinal buttress and raised shoulder arch BEHIND a small intact human-shaped head, not a mushroom crest. Dirty gray-white and oxidized muted green palette, remnants of dark work trousers, no exposed organs.

variants.name: Тягун
variants.design: One single gigantic adult male humanoid, about2.6m implied height, only ONE human head TWO arms TWO legs, no fused bodies. Broad barrel torso bent sharply forward, short powerful legs and two extremely long thick forearms almost reaching ground. Dense braided dark mycelial tendon bundles form a natural yoke across back and shoulder girdle, tough pale knuckle calluses, human face looks upward from beneath brow. Rust-dark brown and chalk-gray palette, remnants of blue maintenance trousers. Distinct gorilla-like weight distribution but clearly mutated HUMAN anatomy, no animal fur.
